verdict.rationale: Publishing entity-type and incorporation-jurisdiction guidance is a fair question for a law firm serving founders, so the axis applies. The evidence covers venture financing "from seed capital to IPOs", M&A and an international office network, but nothing about published guidance on choosing entity types or jurisdictions (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd). Financing structuring and the office footprint are adjacent capabilities, not this one.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes guidance on choosing entity type and jurisdiction of incorporation (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) appropriate to my market
